soundness_flags.label: thm:vector-subsampling
soundness_flags.one_line: The conditional law of T_{B,n} and its coverage interval are undefined because B has no stated conditional resampling distribution and no scalar contrast/interval construction is specified.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:oracle-preservation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The feasible learned-propensity result takes the published true-propensity oracle limit of AvellaMedinaDavisSamorodnitsky2025 as a premise.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Feasible transfer, correction, and joint inference are asserted conditional on the established oracle clipped-IPW quantile limit; this imposes no tier cap.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Theorem 3.1; Appendix Section 8, Propositions 8.2 and 8.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The fixed-quantile theorem is formulated with weights 1/max(e(X_i),b_n), establishes an infinitely divisible limit for gamma in (1,2), and its proof combines the quadratic convex-objective term with the finite-dimensional score limit.
The article studies efficient ATE estimation using a nonparametric/sieve estimated propensity score, rather than weak-overlap QTE limits.
Firpo develops propensity-estimated QTE estimators and establishes root-n consistency, asymptotic normality, efficiency, and variance estimation.
The paper gives irregular IPW/DR limit theory and an adaptive m-out-of-n bootstrap for causal or counterfactual parameters under extreme propensity scores.
The balance-based propensity-score paper derives asymptotic properties for IPW average, distributional, and quantile treatment-effect estimators.
The paper studies thresholded cross-fitted doubly robust mean estimation under weak overlap and nonparametric nuisance estimation, not a quantile convex argmin.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define B as conditionally uniform over all size-m subsets (or define the empirical subsampling measure), name the contrast functional, and give the exact interval/quantile inversion whose coverage is claimed.

Promote the escape result from one perturbation to a generic necessary-and-sufficient oracle-transfer frontier over a stated class of cross-fitted propensity learners, with the escape learner as the sharp witness.

State a single explicit comparison theorem against the true-propensity oracle estimator, quantifying the exact feasible-versus-oracle remainder and the learned-score covariance retained in mixed regimes.

recommended_next_step: Revise the vector-subsampling theorem and definition to specify its conditional resampling law and concrete confidence-set target, then advance the otherwise field-grade novelty kernel to Stage 0.
